model_interpretation.claim: For n in [2,128], the existing route performs one reduction launch and then a device-to-device copy. A single 128-thread CTA can handle these sizes with bounded loads and write directly to out, potentially saving the copy. Preserve n=1's no-kernel copy path because adding a kernel may be slower, and retain the existing hierarchical path above the generic one-CTA capacity.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cu"],"retained":["For 2 <= n <= 128, launch one 128-thread reduce0 CTA that writes its result directly to out, eliminating the intermediate output and final device copy.","Leave the n=1 asynchronous device-to-device copy path and the existing hierarchical reduction fallback for larger sizes unchanged."]}

model_interpretation.claim: For large n, a separate output-zeroing launch followed by one grid-stride reduction launch should reduce launch and scratch-stage overhead versus the existing hierarchy. The tradeoff is one contended int32 atomic per CTA; using 256-thread CTAs, a target of 2048 elements per CTA, and a 1024-CTA cap tests whether this keeps input parallelism high enough without excessive aggregation contention. This remains an unmeasured hypothesis.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cu"],"retained":["For n >= 1<<20, launch an ordered output-zeroing kernel before the reduction kernel on the default stream.","Use 256-thread CTAs to grid-stride over the input, combine each CTA's values with warp reductions, and perform exactly one int32 atomicAdd per CTA; choose ceil(n/2048) CTAs capped at 1024.","Retain the existing hierarchical reduction for smaller positive inputs and explicitly zero the output for n <= 0; the large-input atomic path does not use scratch."]}

items.subject: Combinaison mesurée des voies grande et petite tailles
items.objective: Mesurer une combinaison qui conserve la voie atomique T3 pour les grandes tailles et reprend la voie directe T2 seulement aux tailles où elle est pertinente. Préserver la correction pour toute taille légale et comparer la latence de n=4194304 à la source T3.
